name: UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE)
description: A nationwide competitive examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission for recruitment to various Civil Services of the Government of India, including the IAS, IFS, and IPS.
eligibility: Must be a citizen of India for IAS, IPS, and IFS
Educational Qualification: Must hold a bachelor's degree from a recognized university
Age Limit: 21 to 32 years as on 1st August of the examination year
Age Relaxation: Up to 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and up to 10 years for PwBD candidates
Number of Attempts: General: 6, OBC: 9, SC/ST: Unlimited up to age limit
benefits: Prestigious Group A and Group B central government services
Starting basic pay of ₹56,100 (Level 10) for Group A officers, plus DA, HRA, and TA
Excellent career progression, job security, and social prestige
documents: Aadhaar Card or Valid Photo ID

procedure: Register on the UPSC One Time Registration (OTR) platform (https://upsconline.nic.in)
Fill Part-I of the application with basic details and educational qualifications
Pay the application fee of ₹100 (Female/SC/ST/PwBD candidates are exempted)
Complete Part-II by selecting the exam center and uploading photo/signature
Download and print the submitted application form

verification.notes: Verified from upsc.gov.in annual exam notification rules.

name: SSC Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination
description: An annual examination conducted by the Staff Selection Commission to recruit staff to various Group B and Group C posts in ministries, departments, and organizations of the Government of India.
eligibility: Must be a citizen of India
Educational Qualification: Bachelor's degree from a recognized university
Specific posts (like JSO, AAO) require specific subject qualifications at the degree level
Age Limit: Generally 18 to 27 years or 18 to 32 years, depending on the specific post
Age Relaxation: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, 10 years for PwD
benefits: Recruitment to Group B (Gazetted/Non-Gazetted) and Group C posts
Pay scales range from Pay Level 4 (₹25,500 - ₹81,100) to Pay Level 8 (₹47,600 - ₹1,51,100)
Central Government allowances including DA, HRA, and medical facilities
documents: Scanned Photograph (as per specified dimensions without spectacles/cap) and Signature

procedure: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on the SSC portal (https://ssc.gov.in)
Log in and apply for the CGL Examination under the 'Latest Notifications' tab
Fill in post preferences and examination center choices
Upload required scanned images
Pay the application fee of ₹100 (Exempted for Women/SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen)

verification.notes: Verified from the new SSC portal (ssc.gov.in).

Pay the examination fee (₹1150 for General, ₹600 for Gen-EWS/OBC-NCL, ₹325 for SC/ST/PwD)

name: Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)
description: A national-level eligibility test conducted by CBSE to certify the eligibility of candidates to be appointed as teachers for classes I to VIII in Central Government Schools (KVS, NVS, etc.).
eligibility: For Classes I-V (Paper I): Senior Secondary (or its equivalent) with at least 50% marks and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education (D.El.Ed) OR B.Ed.
For Classes VI-VIII (Paper II): Graduation and passed or appearing in final year of 2-year D.El.Ed OR B.Ed.
As per NCTE guidelines, B.Ed candidates are eligible for Paper II
No age limit for appearing in CTET
benefits: CTET certificate is a mandatory requirement to apply for teaching jobs in Central Govt Schools (KVS, NVS, Central Tibetan Schools)
CTET certificate is valid for a lifetime
Can also be used to apply in schools under the administrative control of UTs
documents: B.Ed / D.El.Ed passing or appearing proof

procedure: Visit the official CTET portal (https://ctet.nic.in)
Click on 'Apply for CTET'
Complete the registration process and note down the Registration Number
Fill the application form and choose Paper I, Paper II, or both
Upload scanned images and pay the fee (For Single Paper: ₹1000 for Gen/OBC, ₹500 for SC/ST/PwD. For Both Papers: ₹1200 for Gen/OBC, ₹600 for SC/ST/PwD)

verification.notes: Verified from CTET Information Bulletin.

name: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE)
description: A national examination that tests comprehensive understanding of various undergraduate subjects in engineering and science, heavily used by leading PSUs (like ONGC, NTPC, IOCL, PowerGrid) for direct recruitment.
authority: IISc and 7 IITs (On behalf of MoE)
eligibility: Candidates currently in the 3rd or higher years of any undergraduate degree program OR
Candidates who have completed any government-approved degree program in Engineering / Technology / Architecture / Science / Commerce / Arts
No age limit to appear for GATE (However, PSUs have their own age limits, usually 26-28 years for recruitment)
benefits: High score guarantees screening for Group A equivalent Executive/Management Trainee positions in Navratna and Maharatna PSUs
Starting packages in PSUs range from ₹12 Lakhs to ₹22 Lakhs per annum
Also serves as the gateway for Master's programs (M.Tech/Ph.D.) in IITs/NITs with financial assistance (MHRD Scholarship)

Valid Photo ID (Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID)

Fill in personal details, select paper(s) (can choose up to two papers from allowed combinations)
Upload required documents, photo, and signature
Pay application fee (approx. ₹900 for Female/SC/ST/PwD, ₹1800 for all other candidates per paper)

verification.notes: Verified from GATE Information Brochure.
